case.summary: This case was triggered by an analyst request monitoring device profile MotoG3 Build/MPIS24.65-33.1-2-16 |  | chrome 66.0 for android | used on 17 cards in Nov-Dec. The graph showed this device profile linked the flagged card to 9 other cards, involving a near-identical purchase within 48 hours on the same device profile. The verdict is fraud with an initial and final fraud probability of 0.99, because of high memory-model scores, shared rare device profiles, and a coordinated low-amount testing pattern. Actions taken include blocking the card, creating a case, monitoring connected cards, and filing a report.
